disclaimer: Only actually observed WATCH events; historical bars receive NO retroactive signal labels.
Horizons require immediately contiguous 15m candles, without overnight jumps.
Positive outcomes describe UNDERLYING DIRECTION ONLY, not option returns.
Event population can contain dependent/repeated symbols; not backtested probabilities.

shadow_action_signal_validation.entry_assumption: Next contiguous 15m candle open; not a guaranteed fill.
shadow_action_signal_validation.exit_assumption: Stop/target checked against future OHLC; if both touch in one candle, stop is assumed first; otherwise horizon close.
shadow_action_signal_validation.sample_note: Underlying-price shadow simulation only; cost scenarios are illustrative, not account-specific and not option P&L.
